patches.upstream_gap: The upstream contributor-attribution gate assumes an active multi-contributor development repository; this fork is a single-maintainer release mirror and instead needs release provenance plus overlay accountability.
patches.retirement_probe: On a future upstream release, inspect its CI for a supported release-mirror or downstream-overlay mode that verifies an immutable upstream release base and a declared patch stack without remapping upstream authors.
patches.retirement_condition: Retire or narrow this patch when upstream supplies behaviorally equivalent fork provenance and overlay auditing.
